relations.subject: Hans Henrich Hock
relations.role: Professor Emeritus of Linguistics and Sanskrit
relations.evidence: Hans Henrich Hock (born 26 September 1938) is a German-born American linguist and Professor Emeritus of Linguistics and Sanskrit at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

relations.subject: Hans Henrich Hock
relations.evidence: Hock holds graduate degrees from Northwestern and Yale universities.
